info.title: Tirosh VitalServer Runtime Control API
info.description: Runtime Control API contract for the common PWA and platform adapters. Its owner-neutral read core is defined by docs/runtime/runtime-v2-route-manifest.json.

get.description: Long-lived SSE stream for platform state updates. The local router keeps the connection open, emits a platform-state frame when the PlatformState payload changes, and sends heartbeat comments while idle.

schema.description: Long-lived SSE frames with id platform-state, event platform-state, and data as a JSON-encoded PlatformState.

get.description: Reads product-facing Lab scenarios. Scenario names are product scenarios and do not expose fixture or source file origins.

Reads the VitalServer-indexed vital file library available to Runtime Lab through the Runtime Control boundary. Authentication, dependency, decode, and invalid-index failures are reported through response state and readError, not as an empty success.
Reads the Product Lab bed read model through the Runtime Control boundary.
Reads the Product Lab recorder read model, including explicit execution send state, through the Runtime Control boundary.
Reads the Product Lab session collection through the Runtime Control boundary.

post.description: Creates a product Lab session through the Runtime Control boundary.

get.description: Reads one product Lab session through the Runtime Control boundary.

post.description: Starts one product Lab session through the Runtime Control boundary.
Pauses one Product Lab session without declaring its recorder archives complete.

post.summary: Finish a Runtime Lab session and upload its Vital files
post.description: Terminates one Product Lab session and requests durable recorder archive finalization.

post.summary: Start a recorder in a running Runtime Lab session
post.description: Starts one recorder owned by the selected running Product Lab session.

post.summary: Stop a recorder in a running Runtime Lab session
post.description: Stops one recorder owned by the selected running Product Lab session.

post.summary: Replay a vital file through Runtime Lab
post.description: Starts a Lab replay from a vital file path inside the configured mounted vital files directory.

post.summary: Upload one or more files to the Vital Files library
post.description: Evaluates every multipart file independently, uploads every valid candidate through VitalServer POST /upload, and verifies accepted uploads through GET /api/filelist. Per-file validation, upload, and index failures are returned in failedFiles without stopping later files; an unavailable VitalServer dependency still fails the request.

200.description: Runtime Lab vital file upload response

get.description: Reads the product service list from the Runtime v2 Guest Control API through the Host Runtime Control boundary.

get.summary: Read Guest product service stack status
get.description: Reads the product service stack status from the Runtime v2 Guest Control API through the Host Runtime Control boundary.

get.summary: Read Redis Relay status owner resource
get.description: Reads the explicit Redis Relay status snapshot from the Runtime Controller owner without reconstructing it from Host status or diagnostics artifacts.

200.description: Explicit Redis Relay status read result

get.summary: Read Runtime-owned Redis Relay settings without secret material

200.description: Explicit Redis Relay settings read result

put.summary: Apply Runtime-owned Redis Relay settings and reconcile Compose

get.description: Reads one product service status from the Runtime v2 Guest Control API through the Host Runtime Control boundary.

get.summary: Read Guest product service controller resource
get.description: Reads one controller-owned Guest service resource from the Runtime v2 Guest Control API through the Host Runtime Control boundary, preserving spec, desired state, observed state, conditions, and last operation identity.

post.description: Requests a product service start through the Runtime v2 Guest Control API and returns the persisted operation document.
Requests a product service stop through the Runtime v2 Guest Control API and returns the persisted operation document.
Requests a product service restart through the Runtime v2 Guest Control API and returns the persisted operation document.

get.summary: Read Guest Runtime Controller operation event history

schema.description: Inclusive ISO-8601 timestamp lower bound with an explicit UTC designator (Z) or numeric UTC offset. Timezone-less timestamps are rejected.
Opaque pagination cursor returned as nextCursor by the previous response.

200.description: Guest Runtime Controller operation event history

503.description: Guest Runtime Controller operation ledger is unavailable. Runtime Control preserves the Guest dependency failure as guestControlUnavailable and does not substitute Host diagnostics.

get.summary: Read current Runtime Controller product settings

post.summary: Replace the Runtime product administrator password

get.summary: Read helper and bundled release metadata

post.description: Restarts the VM, guest log sync, host proxy, and watchdog services.
Requests datastore repair through the Guest Runtime Controller and returns its persisted operation without translating it into Host command output.
Archives the current mutable VM disk, recreates it from the installed base image, and restarts runtime services.

post.summary: Create a managed platform support bundle
post.description: Schedules the platform-specific support collector. The completed durable workflow publishes the managed artifact path, SHA-256 digest, and byte size; the caller does not choose a host path.

delete.description: Compatibility deletion endpoint. Browser clients should prefer Delete Update Backup or Delete VitalServer Backup endpoints so the target backup type stays explicit.
Deletes a managed update/rollback backup. This does not delete VitalServer backups or current runtime data.

post.description: Requests a recoverable Redis-only backup from the Runtime Controller and returns the Platform workflow result.
Creates a recoverable VitalServer backup, including Runtime data, settings, Platform diagnostics, and observability data.

delete.description: Deletes a selected VitalServer backup. This does not delete update rollback backups or current runtime data.

post.description: Restores Redis data, runtime settings, Host diagnostics/export artifacts, start-on-boot state, and runtime observability SQLite from a verified VitalServer backup.

get.summary: Subscribe to local log text updates
get.description: Long-lived SSE stream for host log text updates. The local router keeps the connection open, emits a runtime-log frame when the selected log text changes, and sends heartbeat comments while idle.

schema.description: SSE frame with event runtime-log and data as a JSON-encoded RuntimeLogTextResponse.

202.description: Durable update verification operation accepted by the Platform Agent
Durable update apply operation accepted by the Platform Agent

post.summary: Rollback to the previous installed Platform release
post.description: Schedules a durable Platform-owned rollback workflow. The rollback target comes from the explicit install owner; callers do not provide or infer a release path.

202.description: Durable release rollback operation accepted by the Platform Agent

get.summary: Read the durable Platform delivery workflow owner

post.description: Mutates the Host-owned operation lease through the local Runtime Control API. Diagnostics/export artifacts may mirror lease context, but callers must use this owner contract instead of selecting a file path or repository.

post.summary: Record Host runtime operation lease heartbeat
post.description: Updates heartbeat metadata for the Host-owned operation lease through the local Runtime Control API. Missing or failed owner access must surface as an error, not as an empty operation state.
Releases the Host-owned operation lease through the local Runtime Control API. Clients receive an explicit mutation response and must not infer release state from file absence.

get.description: Reads the Host-owned Guest address resource through Runtime Control API. Loaded, missing, unavailable, and failed states remain distinct; clients must not infer Guest address from runtime-status.json, runtime-observation.json, or file absence.

put.description: Updates the Host-owned Guest address resource through Runtime Control API. This is the owner mutation boundary; callers provide an explicit address rather than relying on file fallback or status projection.

200.description: Guest address resource state after update

get.description: Reads the Host-owned VM lifecycle resource through Runtime Control API. Loaded, missing, unavailable, and failed states remain distinct; clients must not infer VM lifecycle state from runtime-status.json or file absence.

put.description: Updates the Host-owned VM lifecycle resource through Runtime Control API. This is the owner mutation boundary; callers provide an explicit lifecycle document rather than relying on file fallback or status projection.

200.description: VM lifecycle resource state after update

post.description: Requests the OS service manager to start the Runtime Provider. Command completion reports only the Platform effect; clients must read the separately returned Provider lifecycle resource for current Provider state.
Requests the OS service manager to stop the Runtime Provider without converting service-manager state into Provider lifecycle state.
Requests an explicit stop followed by start through the OS service manager. Runtime readiness remains owned by the Provider lifecycle and Runtime Controller contracts.

200.description: Explicit latest VitalDB observation read state. Unavailable and failed reads preserve their readError instead of becoming a null observation.

get.description: Long-lived SSE stream for latest VitalDB observation snapshot changes. Each data frame is a JSON encoded RuntimeVitalDBObservationSnapshot so read state and readError are preserved.

schema.description: SSE frames with event=vitaldb-observed and data=RuntimeVitalDBObservationSnapshot JSON.

get.summary: Read Vital Recorder history by vrcode
get.description: Aggregated VRecorder history derived from stored VitalDB observation snapshots. vrcode is the recorder identity key.

post.description: Marks VRecorders hidden in the Guest/Postgres product read model. Hidden recorders are omitted from default UI lists but remain available when explicitly requested by the UI.

200.description: Vital Recorder history after the hide command.

post.description: Restores hidden VRecorders to the visible Guest/Postgres product read model.

200.description: Vital Recorder history after the unhide command.

post.summary: Delete hidden Vital Recorders by vrcode
post.description: Tombstones hidden VRecorders in the Guest/Postgres product read model. The command must fail when a requested VRecorder is not already hidden.

200.description: Vital Recorder history after the delete command.

get.summary: Read one Vital Recorder by vrcode

404.description: No recorder has been observed for the requested vrcode.

503.description: The Runtime Controller could not read the recorder owner state.

get.summary: Read one Vital Recorder activity chart window
get.description: Lazy chart window for one VRecorder. Runtime v2 reads the selected activity window from Guest/Postgres recorder activity read models; Host SQLite is transitional diagnostics only.

get.summary: Read Vital files attributed to one Vital Recorder
get.description: Lazy detail read that combines explicitly tracked native Recorder uploads with cold-path recovery artifacts. Native uploads are attributed by a declared vrcode or by an exact bedName assignment at the upload receive time. Product Lab files are excluded.

200.description: Recorder Vital-file history with explicit source read states.

get.summary: Read VitalDB bed history by bedID
get.description: Aggregated bed history derived from stored VitalDB observation snapshots. bedID is the bed identity key.

post.description: Marks beds hidden in the Guest/Postgres product read model. Hidden beds are omitted from default UI lists but remain available when explicitly requested by the UI.

200.description: VitalDB bed history after the bed hide command.

post.description: Restores hidden beds to the visible Guest/Postgres product read model.

200.description: VitalDB bed history after the bed unhide command.

post.summary: Delete hidden VitalDB beds by bedID
post.description: Tombstones hidden beds in the Guest/Postgres product read model. The command must fail when a requested bed is not already hidden.

200.description: VitalDB bed history after the bed delete command.

get.summary: Read one VitalDB bed by bedID

404.description: No bed has been observed for the requested bedID.

503.description: The Runtime Controller could not read the bed owner state.

get.summary: Read Vital Recorder and bed relationship history
get.description: Guest/Postgres-owned read model for bed-to-VRecorder assignments and relationship anomalies. Runtime Control consumers must not treat raw VitalDB observation snapshots or Host SQLite projections as the relationship owner.

post.description: Creates explicit Product Lab beds through the Guest-owned Lab service.

200.description: Runtime Lab bed list after creation

post.description: Deletes explicit Product Lab beds and attached Lab recorders through the Guest-owned Lab service.

200.description: Runtime Lab bed list after deletion

post.description: Removes all Product Lab beds and attached Lab recorders through the Guest-owned Lab service.

200.description: Runtime Lab bed list after reset

post.description: Creates explicit Product Lab recorders for existing Lab beds.

200.description: Runtime Lab recorder list after creation

post.description: Deletes explicit Product Lab recorders by recorder ID, vrcode, or session.

200.description: Runtime Lab recorder list after deletion

post.description: Removes all Product Lab recorders while preserving Lab beds.

200.description: Runtime Lab recorder list after reset

get.description: Read the API-owned operation state resource. It preserves unavailable, failed, loaded, and stale operation subresource meanings instead of requiring clients to infer them from PlatformState fields or Host files.

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid Runtime Control token

OperationInProgress.description: A Guest Runtime Controller operation owns the global control lease. The command was not accepted or queued.

NotImplemented.description: Endpoint exists in the contract but is not implemented by the current local read-only server

RuntimeOperation.description: Runtime operation identifier. Clients must preserve unknown values.

RuntimeInstallState.description: Runtime install state identifier. Clients must preserve unknown values.

RuntimeInstallMode.description: Runtime install mode identifier. Clients must preserve unknown values.

RuntimeWorkflowStep.description: Runtime workflow step identifier. Clients must preserve unknown values.

RuntimeInstallOperationState.description: Explicit runtime install operation state read result.

RuntimeOperationLeaseState.description: Explicit runtime operation lease read result. The lease is Host-owned operation state; stale, missing, and failed reads must not be collapsed.

RuntimeVitalRecorderHistory.description: Aggregated history of VRecorders keyed by vrcode.

readError.description: Recorder history read issue. Present when observation/current/activity projection reads failed and the recorders/beds lists may be incomplete.

RuntimeVitalBedHistory.description: Aggregated history of VitalDB beds keyed by bedID.

readError.description: Bed history read issue. Present when the Guest/Postgres bed read document is failed or incomplete.

RuntimeVitalBedHistorySummary.description: Provider-owned summary for the derived VitalDB Bed history read model.

RuntimeVitalRecorderHistorySummary.description: Provider-owned summary for the derived Vital Recorder and Bed history read model.

RuntimeVitalRecorderActivityHistory.description: Metadata for the durable recorder activity bucket projection used by recorder charts.

unattributedCount.description: Tracked native uploads that could not be attributed because no exact assignment was available. This count is diagnostic and does not create Recorder identity.

observationCount.description: Number of stored VitalDB observation snapshots that included this VRecorder identity after same-snapshot duplicates were collapsed.

duplicateObservationCount.description: Number of extra source recorder records collapsed because they shared this VRecorder identity in a snapshot.

latestAnomalyKind.description: Kind of the latest current anomaly for this VRecorder, or null when no current anomaly exists.

latestAnomalyMessage.description: Message from the latest current anomaly for this VRecorder, or null when no current anomaly exists.

latestAnomalyObservedAt.description: Timestamp of the latest current anomaly for this VRecorder, or null when no current anomaly exists.

presentInLatestObservation.description: True when this recorder is present in the latest VitalDB observation snapshot; false means it is historical.

activityTimeline.description: Chronological activity samples for the VRecorder, derived from VitalDB observer snapshots.

redisIPSync.description: Recorder-specific Redis ip_<vrcode> synchronization state reported by the recorder ingress.

observability.description: Explicit Recorder health-report support and report state. Null means the provider contract did not include observability.

expectedSince.description: Time from which a first health report is explicitly expected for a supported Recorder deployment.

recorderVersion.description: Recorder application version captured by the explicit support expectation.

producerVersion.description: Observability producer version captured by the explicit support expectation.

protocolVersion.description: Observability protocol version captured by the explicit support expectation.

RuntimeVitalRecorderActivityBucket.description: One recorder activity bucket from the VitalDB observer.

RuntimeVitalRecorderActivityPoint.description: Windowed VRecorder data activity sample suitable for UI charts.

buckets.description: Per-bucket activity values from the latest observer window.

RuntimeVitalBedRecord.description: Aggregated history of one VitalDB bed keyed by bedID.

linkedRecorderStatus.description: Explicit status of the VRecorder linked to this bed, or null when no linked recorder record is available.

linkedRecorderIP.description: IP address reported by the VRecorder linked to this bed, or null when no linked recorder record is available.

linkedRecorderLastSeenAt.description: Last seen timestamp reported by the VRecorder linked to this bed, or null when no linked recorder record is available.

observationCount.description: Number of stored VitalDB observation snapshots that included this bed identity after same-snapshot duplicates were collapsed.

duplicateObservationCount.description: Number of extra source bed records collapsed because they shared this bed identity in a snapshot.

latestAnomalyKind.description: Kind of the latest current anomaly for this bed, or null when no current anomaly exists.

latestAnomalyMessage.description: Message from the latest current anomaly for this bed, or null when no current anomaly exists.

latestAnomalyObservedAt.description: Timestamp of the latest current anomaly for this bed, or null when no current anomaly exists.

RuntimeVitalRelationshipHistory.description: Derived assignment and relationship event history between VitalDB beds and VRecorders.

events.description: Newest relationship transition events in the requested page.

eventTotalCount.description: Total number of relationship transition events owned by the Guest read model.

eventLimit.description: Maximum number of newest relationship transition events included in this response.

readError.description: Relationship projection read issue. Present when assignments or relationship events could not be read completely.

capabilities.description: Capability identifiers supplied explicitly by the Runtime Controller.

guestControlBaseURL.description: Optional development override for the Guest Control API base URL.

runtimeInstallationState.description: Explicit Platform Agent runtime installation state. Missing, present-but-not-executable, inspection failure, and executable are distinct.

services.description: Platform Agent-owned service states keyed by cross-platform role. Every fixed cross-platform role is present exactly once; a platform reports unavailable or not-installed rather than omitting a role. Platform implementations map launchd, Windows Service, or systemd state into the same roles.

runtimeEndpoint.description: Platform Agent-reported endpoint of the Runtime Controller. For VM providers this is the VM address; for native providers it is the local endpoint.

platformAPIHTTP.description: HTTP reachability status for the local Platform API and Remote Console server.

platformAPIStartedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp for the local Platform API server start time.

nextCursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page. Explicit null when there is no next page.

matchingCount.description: Total number of events matching the query before applying limit pagination. Explicit null when the Guest ledger cannot compute a total.

httpStatus.description: HTTP status or explicit probe status text returned by the recorder ingress status read attempt.

RuntimeDataDirectoryStats.description: Recursive visible-file summary for the configured Vital files directory.

recorderIngressSendDataReplayMaxMiBPerSe.description: Maximum recorder send_data replay throughput in MiB/s.

containerMemoryLimitsEnabled.description: Whether Docker hard memory limits are applied to selected runtime containers.

vitalServerContainerMemoryLimitMiB.description: VitalServer container hard memory limit in MiB when container memory limits are enabled.

recorderIngressContainerMemoryLimitMiB.description: Recorder ingress container hard memory limit in MiB when container memory limits are enabled.

redisContainerMemoryLimitMiB.description: Redis container hard memory limit in MiB when container memory limits are enabled.

helperMessage.description: Legacy helper message field. Send null when the caller is reading the append-only helper message log.

VitalDBRecorderActivityObservation.description: Recent VRecorder send_data activity summarized from the recorder ingress Redis list.

PlatformOperationState.description: Platform Agent-owned operation state. Missing install state, failed reads, stale leases, and loaded operation documents remain distinct.

activeOperation.description: Operation selected by the operation-state owner for client display and refresh decisions. Clients must not recompute it from PlatformState, install, or lease subresources.

RuntimeProviderState.description: Observed VM lifecycle state. Unknown values are preserved by clients.

RuntimeProviderError.description: Observed VM domain error code. The API may return newer codes; clients should preserve unknown values.

RuntimeEndpointResourceState.description: Platform Agent-owned Runtime endpoint resource. Missing, unavailable, failed, stale, and loaded states remain distinct.

RuntimeProviderLifecycleState.description: Known VM lifecycle states. Unknown string values are preserved by the Swift contract.

RuntimeProviderTerminalReason.description: Known terminal VM lifecycle reasons. Unknown string values are preserved by the Swift contract.

RuntimeProviderResourceState.description: Platform Agent-owned Runtime Provider lifecycle resource. Apple VM, Hyper-V VM, and Linux Native providers map their explicit lifecycle into this contract.

RuntimeEndpointSource.description: Source that produced the explicit Guest address read result.

RuntimeEndpointReadState.description: Explicit Guest address read state. Missing, invalid, stale, and read-failed are distinct from a loaded address.
